guest_bio_html: Melanie Harlow is a USA Today bestselling romance author based in Detroit. A former high school English teacher, she self-published her first books in 2013 and moved into contemporary romance in 2014. Most of her small-town series, including Cloverleigh Farms, are set in northern Michigan. Her newsletter has more than 180,000 subscribers, built largely on the bonus scene opt-in she explains in this episode.
